title: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1956

sections.title: Short title.
sections.content: This act may be called the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1956.

sections.title: Maximum number of Supreme Court Judges other than Chief Justice.
sections.content:
The maximum
number of Judges of the Supreme Court, excluding the Chief Justice of India, shall be
^1[thirty-three].
